title: Unconscious but breathing — recovery position
scenario: Person passed out, fainted, unresponsive or will not wake up, but IS breathing normally.
steps: Check breathing: look for steady chest movement, listen and feel for breath.
If breathing is normal and no spinal injury is suspected, roll them onto their side into the recovery position: bottom arm out, top knee bent, head tilted slightly back so the airway stays open.
Keep their mouth pointed slightly downward so fluids can drain.
Stay with them and re-check breathing every minute until help arrives.
If breathing stops or becomes abnormal gasping, roll them onto their back and start CPR.
do_not: Do not leave them lying flat on their back unattended — the tongue or vomit can block the airway.
Do not move them if a neck or back injury is suspected, unless the airway is at risk.
